comment: Server-only core files (those importing @devvit/web/server) are excluded: under the browser condition that import resolves to a stub with no `redis`. The client never imports these, so excluding them is safe. If you add another core file that imports @devvit/web/server, add it here too. __tests__ are excluded too: tests are server-side (they use the redis mock) and are type-checked by tsconfig.server.json, never shipped to the client.
